structured_output.summary: The diff implements Array.prototype.sort in prototype_sort.rs, with helpers sort_indexed_properties, compare_array_elements and a stable merge_sort. I checked each spec step against the code. The IsCallable check runs before ToObject, and LengthOfArrayLike follows. SortIndexedProperties uses HasProperty then Get per index, with skip-holes handled. CompareArrayElements follows steps 1-11, including the NaN-to-+0 rule. The Set loop over the sorted list is followed by the DeletePropertyOrThrow loop from j to length. Every fallible operation uses `?`. The merge sort is stable and stops at the first abrupt completion. There are no test-shaped branches, no made-up values and no swallowed errors. The only unrelated-looking change is removing the stub's NOTE and subclause comments. Those are documentation of the same function, not functional changes, so I did not count them. The gate shows 81 new passes with no regressions, and the remaining failures are caused by other unimplemented built-ins (ArrayBuffer, RegExp, Array.prototype.pop, String.prototype.slice), which are correctly reported as not-implemented.
structured_output.notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found. The diff can be merged as is. Optional: restore the spec NOTE comments and [subclause] references that were deleted from the stub, to keep the spec mapping complete. Also note that sort_indexed_properties is pub(crate) and can be reused by TypedArray sort with skip_holes=false.
